method: Reverse-DCF by bisection: solve the 10-yr FCF growth that sets (PV of 10 yrs + terminal at 2.5%/10% discount + net cash)/shares equal to the latest close. Excludes banks/insurers (JPM, GS, UNH) and pre-revenue/negative-FCF story names.
